authority: Original PR #1 alpha-discovery continuation under the user's terminal-wealth-first authorization.

current_alpha_leader.finding: High-exposure campaign ownership with sparse absolute-score displacement materially improves full-history wealth in all three scopes, but 2023-2025 union still regresses.

trend_quality_failure.finding: Using cross-sectional trend-quality percentiles for both admission and campaign-reference displacement causes 44/46 broad-scope displacements and regresses broad wealth. Percentiles are contemporaneously comparable but not stable campaign references.

native_full_cap_failure.finding: Old-score admission under permanently high exposure damages broad capital before later leadership handoffs, so admission quality remains a live bottleneck.

economic_hypothesis: Opportunity discovery and ownership require different score semantics. Cross-sectional trend quality can rank which fresh opportunity deserves a newly available slot, while the original absolute causal score is better suited to time-series campaign decay and challenger displacement. Decoupling these roles should improve broad-pool entry quality without the percentile-reference churn seen in offensive_trend_quality.

treatment.discovery_score: Use offensive_trend_quality.trend_quality unchanged. It is the frozen geometric mean of current-session percentiles for 40-session directional efficiency, prior-40-session-high follow-through and 10-session persistence above existing EMA20.
treatment.ownership_score: Use the unchanged techquant.features.score from build_features(Config()) for campaign references, decay and challenger displacement. No weight, horizon or threshold is changed.
treatment.vacancy_admission: Keep the offensive alpha-decay eligibility gate and observed-cash funding semantics. When a real vacancy exists, rank currently eligible unheld/nonretired names only by discovery_score and choose the highest discovery-quality names. At the same close, record the chosen names' ownership_score as pending campaign references; bind those references only once actual inventory is observed.
treatment.full_book_displacement: When the book is full and intact, ignore discovery_score. Reuse the offensive-alpha-decay absolute-score ownership rule unchanged: a held incumbent must have current ownership_score below its own frozen admission ownership_score, and the strongest currently eligible challenger by ownership_score must exceed that frozen reference. Then request only that incumbent exit; do not spend expected sale proceeds on the same close.
treatment.retirement: A voluntarily displaced symbol remains retired until a later security-specific trend campaign break; blocked sale attempts retry without creating a new displacement epoch.
treatment.security_and_execution: Unchanged security exits, broad market admission, close-decision/next-session execution, sells before buys, cash-only long-only, no leverage/shorting, prior-volume capacity, board lots, T+1, fees, slippage and price limits.

structural_difference_from_prior_failure: Unlike offensive_trend_quality, cross-sectional percentiles are never compared to a historical percentile reference; they are used only to rank simultaneous vacancy candidates.
Unlike offensive_native_ownership, fresh admissions no longer use the old scalar score ranking under full exposure.
Unlike the old ranking learner, nothing is fitted and no future label or coefficient exists.
Unlike adjacent parameter searches, the exact previously preregistered quality formula and existing absolute-score ownership rule are reused without a new numeric threshold.

measurement.primary_objective: maximize mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary_objective: maximize minimum terminal wealth across the three fixed scopes
measurement.promotion_rule: Advance only if mean-log wealth and minimum wealth improve, at least one broad scope improves, and joint optical-leader removal remains above 1.0; a tiny 1-2% change is not enough for later formal promotion.
measurement.failure_rule: Preserve any rejection and change architecture rather than tuning quality component weights, horizons, displacement thresholds or position count.

prohibitions: No neighboring parameter or weight grid
